tasks.name: Model List and Budgets
tasks.objective: Produce the Model List and Budgets for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every required model listed with owner, priority and triangle budget
LOD and collision requirements stated per model class
Reuse plan showing which models can be instanced or reskinned

tasks.name: Model Pack
tasks.objective: Produce the Model Pack for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every model is within its triangle budget and has correct scale and pivot
UVs are packed, normals correct and materials named to convention
Each model has LODs and a collision proxy where the budget requires it

tasks.name: Topology and Budget Review
tasks.objective: Produce the Topology and Budget Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Measured triangle and draw-call counts attached per model
Non-manifold geometry, inverted normals and missing UVs listed as zero
Every model imports cleanly into the project pipeline
